references.text: The kings of Canaan fought at Taanach, by the waters of Megiddo. This verse mentions the same cities, Taanach and Megiddo, in connection with Canaanite kings.
Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Taanach and Megiddo. This verse refers to the same cities and shows that the Israelites did not fully conquer these areas.
Taanach is mentioned as part of Solomon's administrative district, showing the city's continued importance after the conquest.
Megiddo is mentioned as one of the cities Solomon fortified, linking it to the strategic significance of the city conquered under Joshua.
Megiddo is mentioned in connection with King Ahaziah's death, showing the city's continued strategic importance.
Harmagedon (from Hebrew Har Megiddo - Mount Megiddo) is mentioned as the place of the final great battle. This links the end-times prophecy to the historical battlefield at Megiddo.
